question: Who among the following won Chess.com’s 2020 Junior Speed Online Chess Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __Nihal Sarin__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nihal Sarin won Chess.com's 2020 Junior Speed Online Chess Championship after beating Russia's Alexey Sarana.
 
 
• A chess child prodigy from Kerala.
 
• Nihal Sarin became India’s 53rd Grandmaster after attaining his third and final Grand Master norm in the Abu Dhabi Masters
 
• He is only the third grandmaster from Kerala after GN Gopal and SL Narayanan.
 
• He is the twelfth youngest grandmaster in chess history.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anton Vladimirovich Smirnov **is an Australian chess player.

 
 
• He was awarded the title of Grandmaster by FIDE in 2017.
 
 
 
• **Alexey Vasilyevich Sarana** is a Russian chess grandmaster.
 
• **Andrew Tang** is an American chess grandmaster.
 
 
• He is also a popular streamer, known online for his speed chess skills.
